_comment: Times are LOCAL to the timezone above - the code converts to UTC itself,
so these stay correct across the winter/summer clock change.
Use quarter-hour times (:00 :15 :30 :45) for exact firing; anything else
goes out at the start of its 15-minute window.
'image' is relative to /public. 'days' takes short weekday names or 'daily'.
Set 'enabled': false to park a post without deleting it.
